title: What You Believe
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary: The most important thing in life is what you believe. It shapes everything in your life: how you think, how you feel, how you treat people, how you survive your worst day. Yet few examine it, and what's worse, we live in a world that tells us belief doesn't even matter. In this series we're looking at what it means to be a Christian.
quotes: What you believe will make or break you.
Faith was never one thing. It's three.
Living faith moves. Dead faith is a corpse.
